Very high-quality Korean food
Aug 2026 • Couples
This is something! It was incredibly delicious! My spouse and I are fans of Korean food and know our stuff. We went to try delicious Korean BBQ and didn't make a wrong choice. We took marinated beef and pork, vegetables, kimbap. Meat with vegetables were fried right in front of us. It was very tasty. All dishes are the freshest. No, not like that, very, very delicious!). Many free snacks, panchan, were brought before the main meal. I liked the omelet, so they brought it for me 3 extra times at my request. The service is excellent - everything is fast and polite. We ate so much deliciousness until we were full and were very satisfied. And when they brought the bill, we were very, very surprised because the price in rubles came out to 3400. This is with two liters of delicious beer and a bottle of soju. Compared to Moscow Korean restaurants, the price here is four times cheaper.

Truly one of the best restaurants in downtown Nha Trang
Jul 2026 • Couples
We decided to have dinner somewhere new and we were happy! This is not plastic furniture as is customary throughout Vietnam, but a full-fledged restaurant. The meal table in front of you is transformed into a grill table. You place an order, you bring groceries to cook, you can fire yourself, or you can ask a waiter. We asked us to cook. Ordered: pork chin, beef, shrimp, mini squid, grilled vegetables. They brought in the mangal with the charcoal ready, put the griddle down, and started frying. Simultaneously, various kimchi-type pickles were offered. The check went to 1 million VDN. A very unusual experience, I recommend this institution to everyone, the ratings are unscrewed, but real.
